meta_description:
59K likes, 185 comments - cosmoindia on September 29, 2026: "Kalyani Priyadarshan (@kalyanipriyadarshan) for Cosmopolitan India’s 30th anniversary cover! 🌟 

To say it’s been a whirlwind year for Kalyani Priyadarshan (@kalyanipriyadarshan) would be an understatement. After leading the genre- blending, crowd-pleasing Malayalam film ‘Lokah Chapter 1: Chandra’ (2025), the actor garnered a bevy of awards, including the Kerala Film Critics Association Award. Magazine covers, endorsements, and landing on multiple ‘Best of...’ lists, was punctuated by appearances at the Cannes Film Festival and Wimbledon.

In a heart-to-heart with Cosmo, the rising star chats about her super-speed year, growing up under the spotlight, and the idea of smashing the lens in an era of non-stop scrutiny. 

Read her full cover story at the link in bio, and grab a copy of our 30th anniversary issue of September-October’26, on newsstands now!

Editor: Snigdha Ahuja (@snigdha.ahuja)
Interview: Karishma Upadhyay (@karishmaupadhyay)
Photographer: Aastha Manchanda (@manchandaa)
Stylist: Nishtha Parwani (@nishthaparwani)
Cover Design: Mandeep Singh Khokhar (@mandy_khokhar19)
Makeup Artist: Sahithya Shetty (@sahithya.shetty)
Hair Artist: Daksh Nidhi (@dakshhnidhi)
Editorial Coordinator: Shalini Kanojia (@shalinikanojia)
Fashion Assistants: Maitri Desai (@maitriidesaii) and Ria Kothari (@ria.kothari)
Fashion Intern: Siddhi Goswami (@styledbysiddhig)
Artist PR Agency: Aurum Entertainment (@aurum_entpr)

On Kalyani: Outfit, Falguni Shane Peacock (@falgunishanepeacock); jewellery, Golden Gazelle (@goldengazellegems)

#CosmopolitanIndia #CoverShoot #CosmoCoverStar #KalyaniPriyadarshan #30YearsofCosmoIndia".
